### Symbols for curvature and gravity

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $\Gamma^k_{ij}$ | Christoffel symbols of the Levi-Civita connection |
| $\nabla_i$ | covariant derivative, $\nabla_i X^k = \partial_i X^k + \Gamma^k_{ij}X^j$ |
| $R^\rho{}_{\sigma\mu\nu}$ | Riemann tensor |
| $R_{\sigma\nu}$, $\operatorname{Ric}$ | Ricci tensor, $R_{\sigma\nu} = R^\rho{}_{\sigma\rho\nu}$ |
| $R$ | scalar curvature, $R = g^{\sigma\nu}R_{\sigma\nu}$ |
| $G_{\mu\nu}$ | Einstein tensor, $R_{\mu\nu} - \tfrac12 R\, g_{\mu\nu}$ |
| $T_{\mu\nu}$ | energy-momentum tensor |
| $G_N$ | Newton's constant |
| $\kappa$ | gravitational coupling, $\kappa^2 = 8\pi G_N$ |
| $\Lambda$ | cosmological constant |
| $e^a{}_\mu$ | vielbein (frame) |
| $\omega_\mu{}^{ab}$ | spin connection |
| $h_{\mu\nu}$, $\bar h_{\mu\nu}$ | metric perturbation and its trace reverse |

Conventions:

- $\Gamma^k_{ij} = \tfrac12 g^{kl}(\partial_i g_{lj} + \partial_j g_{li} - \partial_l g_{ij})$.
- $R^\rho{}_{\sigma\mu\nu} = \partial_\mu \Gamma^\rho_{\nu\sigma} - \partial_\nu \Gamma^\rho_{\mu\sigma}
  + \Gamma^\rho_{\mu\lambda} \Gamma^\lambda_{\nu\sigma} - \Gamma^\rho_{\nu\lambda} \Gamma^\lambda_{\mu\sigma}$, and
  $R_{\sigma\nu} = R^\rho{}_{\sigma\rho\nu}$. With these signs the round unit sphere has $R = +2$, and in the signature
  $(+, -, -, -)$ de Sitter space has $R < 0$.
- The Einstein-Hilbert action is $S = -\frac{1}{2\kappa^2}\int d^4x\, \sqrt{-g}\, R$, so Einstein's equations read
  $G_{\mu\nu} = \kappa^2 T_{\mu\nu}$.
